upstream_negative_context.issue_claim: HTTP/1.1 request bodies split across SSL_write events can be emitted incompletely because Content-Length is not used as a completeness gate before HTTP event emission.
upstream_negative_context.scope_note: The full multi-SSL_write/eBPF path from issue #185 was NOT reproduced in this experiment.

source_observation.parse_http_message_behavior: The current 1.0.30 parser collects all currently available bytes after CRLFCRLF as the body and returns Some(HTTPMessage) without comparing body length with the Content-Length header.
source_observation.handle_ssl_event_behavior: The current source calls parse_http_message on one SSL event and immediately constructs an HTTP event when parsing succeeds; no HTTP/1.1 accumulation state is visible in HTTPParser alongside its HTTP2 and WebSocket state.

finding.claim: AgentSight 1.0.30 HTTPParser accepts an intentionally incomplete HTTP/1.1 message with Content-Length 10 and only 3 available body bytes as a parsed message.

counterhypothesis_update.statement: The defect class does not invalidate AgentSight as a process/file/network/resource witness; it specifically weakens semantic completeness of reconstructed HTTP/LLM payload observations unless completeness is independently established.

f2_implications: AgentSight remains a bounded READ_ONLY_INDEPENDENT_OBSERVABILITY_WITNESS candidate, never canonical state or effect authority.
An F2 adapter must preserve capture source, confidence, completeness/partiality and raw-versus-derived provenance.
AgentSight HTTP payload absence or truncation must never prove absence of an effect, tool call, completion or causal event.
Do not feed reconstructed HTTP payload semantics into EffectGate/EffectJournal truth without an independently complete F2 causal binding.
Prefer process/file/network/resource witness dimensions for the first F2 ablation; gate HTTP semantic payload use behind explicit completeness checks or disable it.

next_exact_gate.test: Run one no-real-effect equivalent workload under F2-native telemetry alone and F2-native plus AgentSight witness. Include a deliberately split HTTP/1.1 request and independently known process/file/network events. Measure incremental event recall, false/partial attribution, completeness flags, p50/p95/p99 latency, CPU, RSS, I/O, dependency/startup cost and privilege requirements.
next_exact_gate.acceptance_rule: No E5 handoff unless AgentSight adds unique useful witness coverage or debugging value after accounting for telemetry overlap and parser incompleteness, while remaining structurally incapable of minting canonical state/effect/completion authority.
